args.content:
WITH kalemler AS (
    SELECT u.kategori, sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat AS ciro
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    JOIN siparisler s ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    JOIN urunler u ON u.id = sk.urun_id
    WHERE s.tarih LIKE '2025-%'
),
toplam AS (
    SELECT kategori, SUM(ciro) AS ciro
    FROM kalemler
    GROUP BY kategori
),
tutar_toplam AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ciro), 0.0) AS toplam_ciro
    FROM kalemler
)
SELECT t.kategori,
       ROUND(COALESCE(t.ciro, 0.0), 2) AS ciro,
       ROUND(CASE WHEN tt.toplam_ciro > 0 THEN COALESCE(t.ciro, 0.0) * 100.0 / tt.toplam_ciro ELSE 0 END, 1) AS yuzde,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.ciro, 0.0) DESC) AS sira
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT kategori FROM urunler) t
LEFT JOIN toplam ON toplam.kategori = t.kategori
CROSS JOIN tutar_toplam tt
ORDER BY sira ASC, t.kategori ASC;
